text:
Suzie: 🎉 Quick PSA — it's my 5-year Redwood-versary AND my birthday today! Bringing homemade pastel de nata (Portuguese custard tarts) at 3pm in the kitchen (table by the fridge). Drop by for sugar and mild nostalgia. 
Zara: omg congrats!! :tada: will swing by, saving one for you? :)
Kevin: Huge congrats Suzie!! 5 yrs already. I’ll bring coffee ☕️
Ana: YASSSS!!! Do we do a tiny roast + kudos? I can DJ an awkward 10s speech. :microphone:
Priya: Pastel de nata > cake. See you at 3 ♥️
Ops-bot: Reminder set: "Suzie's treats" @ 15:00 in office kitchen — added to #kitchen-calendar (automated ping 10m before)
Jen: tiny ask — can we do a 30s 'Suzie moment' round? I'll go first: the person who still remembers the infamous memory-leak incident gets a sticker.
Suzie: ok fine, spoilers: it was a missing nil check in the midnight batch job that triggered the pizza alerts 🍕🙈 (I still sleep with logs)
Zara: wait pizza alerts? that is content. story time at the table??
Kevin: I vote for stickers AND a group selfie for the 5yr scrapbook.
Ana: also agree on selfie + badge. bringing a balloon.
Priya: i'll bring napkins and an emergency teapot.
Suzie: thank youuuuu!! if you can't make it, no pressure — but if you do, I will personally deputize you to fix my next bug 😅
Jen: noted. See you all at 3. :confetti_ball:
